Lots of people only floss right before a dentist appointment. Your toothbrush can't reach between your teeth. That's exactly where food and plaque love to hide.

But here's the twist. Plaque left there can harden into tartar, and gum disease can sneak in without any pain, and it's even been linked to heart disease! The American Dental Association says clean between your teeth once a day. Water flossers and tiny brushes between the teeth count too.
